original.statement: The controller now always sets Application status.health.lastTransitionTime (bug fix).

decision.reason: [ev-5d698f8b4038] is a controller bug fix saying the controller now "always set[s] health.status.lastTransitionTime". The configuration stays the same and only how the controller fills the field changes, so behavior-changed is the right type. The CRD validator confirms that argoproj.io Application status.health.lastTransitionTime exists in the schema of both releases [ev-be3337c2717d][ev-04f25237d9d5]. The changelog writes the path as "health.status", not the schema's "status.health", so mapping it to that field is an interpretation, which is why confidence is low.
